subject: Can we condense the demo week of Aug 17? Unexpected customer site visit
messages:
From: Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@lakesidebiotech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — scheduling

Hi Priya,

Quick heads up — I just got pulled onto a last-minute customer site visit for Monday/Tuesday next week (Aug 17–18). The rest of my buying group is traveling with me, so our previously penciled 60–75 minute demo slot won't work for the on-site days.

We remain very interested — can we either: a) condense to a focused 30-minute walkthrough on Tuesday afternoon, or b) split into two 20-minute sessions (platform overview + integration questions) across Tuesday/Wednesday? If neither works, we can do a recorded walkthrough and follow with a short live Q&A.

Sorry for the scramble — this customer visit came up after travel plans were finalized. Appreciate any flexibility.

Thanks,
Jordan Pierce
Senior IT Procurement
Lakeside Biotech
Phone: (415) 555-0147

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@lakesidebiotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — scheduling

Hi Jordan — thanks for the update and congrats on the customer visit (sounds busy!).

We can absolutely accommodate a condensed option. Two quick proposals so your team can pick what fits best:

- Option A (single compact): 30-minute focused walkthrough (30 min) — cover hosted API, latency/cost levers, and a quick Q&A. Good when decision-makers need a high-level view.
- Option B (split deep-dive): 20-minute product walkthrough + 20-minute technical integration session with Marissa (our solutions engineer) — spread across two days or back-to-back depending on your cadence.

I attached a slimmed "compact-demo-agenda-30m.docx" that shows what we’d hit in 30 minutes and a trimmed PDF of the latest deck. If you confirm which option, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and loop in the right folks.

If you prefer the recorded route, we can record a ~22-minute walkthrough and schedule a 15-minute live Q&A.

Option availability: Tue Aug 18 2:00–3:30pm PT (we have a 2:30–3:00 slot free for 30m), Wed Aug 19 morning 9:00–11:00am PT. Let me know what works and which option you prefer.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Priya: (650) 555-0198
redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf (slide deck, 18 pages)
Attachment: compact-demo-agenda-30m.docx (outline)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@lakesidebiotech.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — scheduling

Thanks for looping me in. For Option B (split), I'm happy to own the technical 20-minute session and focus on: integration touchpoints, auth/KMS model, VPC/private deployment considerations, and performance profiling for your expected sequences.

If you do Option A (30m), I can dial in for the second half (Q&A) in case there are integration questions.

Small ask: if the buying group has specific workflows or an architecture diagram, send that over and I'll tailor the technical 20 minutes. If not, I'll prepare a short checklist to cover common integration concerns.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@lakesidebiotech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — scheduling

Hi Priya / Marissa — thanks, both. Let’s do Option B (split sessions). Proposed times from our side:

- Tue Aug 18 2:20–2:40pm PT — product walkthrough (20m)
- Wed Aug 19 9:30–9:50am PT — technical Q&A with Marissa (20m)

I’ll send a calendar invite to these slots and include our head of integrations (Claire Wong) on the tech session. I’ll also attach a quick architecture snippet from our internal wiki for context.

If anything changes (travel runs long), we may need to pivot to the recorded Q&A — but for now we’re good. Appreciate the flexibility and the condensed agenda.

Jordan

Attachment: lakeside-arch-snippet.png (architecture sketch)
